subject: Decision verification: MAP milestones & first-week start schedule
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@lumenhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurements <procurements@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP & evaluation wrap — proposed activation gate + start week

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the MAP you shared in yesterday's demo. Attached are the Lumen MAP v3 and the preliminary evaluation results the pilot team pulled together this morning. High level: performance looks aligned with our expectations for the targeted workflows, and cost projection sits within the budget envelope if the prefix caching and quantization recommendations are applied (we flagged the two hot-path prompts in tab/tab).

We're at the procurement checkpoint and need to lock the operational milestones so our Legal/Procurement can sign the PO and push the first-week schedule. Can you confirm the following from Redwood side?
- Final approval path (names/titles) required for signature and SOW acceptance
- Expected Esign window once DocuSign envelope is created (typical turnaround you see)
- Any non-negotiable SLA or start-date constraints we should be aware of

We'd love a firm go/no-go target for our internal calendar: ideally a decision by Friday 18 Feb so we can keep the target start week of 1 Mar. If Redwood needs an earlier timeline for SOW edits, let us know — we can be flexible with small redlines.

Attachments: Lumen_MAP_v3.pdf; Evaluation_Results.xlsx

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Senior Program Manager, AI Initiatives
LumenHealth

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Feb 2027 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation wrap — proposed activation gate + start week

Hi Elaine — really useful deck and the eval exports are helpful, thanks. Quick answers and proposed steps from Redwood: 

1) Approval path (internal):
   - Sales approval / commercial sign: Stephanie Nguyen, Head of Partnerships (me)
   - Legal review & signoff on SOW: Laura Bennett, Senior Counsel
   - Finance/PO intake: Monica Patel, Billing & Procurement Ops (will confirm invoicing cadence)

2) DocuSign turnaround: once SOW + minor redlines are agreed, we typically create and send envelope same day; typical customer signature window for this sized deal is 48–96 hours. If procurement needs pre-signed PO to expedite, Monica can accept emailed PO and we can start onboarding prep earlier.

3) SLAs/constraints: no hard stop for a 1 Mar start as long as signatures are completed by 25 Feb and any technical blockers flagged by the evaluation team are triaged. The only gating items from Redwood side are: final SOW T&C acceptance, PO or signed agreement, and access plan for the VPC/credentials (we'll provide onboarding checklist).

Proposed MAP milestones (we can convert to the mutual action plan doc you already have):
- By 11 Feb: Redwood sends SOW v2 with tracked redlines (attached)
- 12–18 Feb: Legal & Procurement review / commercial Q&A
- By 18 Feb: Decision window for go/no-go (aim for signed DocuSign or committed PO)
- 22–24 Feb: Onboarding kickoff + credentials exchange
- 01 Mar: Target first-week start (training + small-batch traffic)

I've attached Redwood_SOW_draft_v2.docx for your team to review. If you want, I can book a 30-min alignment call early next week to walk Legal through the very small SOW changes.

Best,
Stephanie
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Team — forwarding Elaine's note and our reply. Quick internal run:

Karthik — can you confirm the throughput profile we used in the cost model (I flagged the prefix caching assumptions)? I want to be sure Finance is comfortable with the consumption estimate that Procurement will see.

Laura — legal highlighted two small contract items we typically push in SOWs for MAP-based pilots: indemnity carve-out for third-party hosted models and a 30-day data retention SLA for evaluation logs. Can you indicate whether we can accept Lumen's standard edits or if we need to push back? If you can turn in a first-pass redline within 48 hours, we can keep the 18 Feb decision window.

Monica — procurement wants an initial PO template; if they send PO early we can begin onboarding prep (ssh key exchange + VPC network prep) before the envelope is signed. What's the minimum we can accept as an interim commitment?

SOW attached: Redwood_SOW_draft_v2.docx (please add Legal redlines directly)

If everyone agrees, I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope and the onboarding checklist for Lumen on Wednesday.

Thanks,
Stephanie

Hi Stephanie — quick update from procurement/legal side: we reviewed Redwood_SOW_draft_v2 and the team is comfortable with almost all items. There are two tiny wording requests:

1) Add a single-sentence data handling note to the SOW that evaluation logs will be retained for 30 days (we saw Redwood's proposed 7-day default in the docs).
2) Clarify the support window for the first-week ramp (Lumen requests 9am–5pm PT coverage for the first five business days).

Both are non-material for our procurement; we can accept them as tracked redlines so long as Redwood puts them in the DocuSign envelope. Procurement will sign the PO once those two lines are present. We should be ready to sign by 18 Feb. Attached is the PO they asked us to send: Lumen_PO_12345.pdf.

Can you:
- Confirm you will add the two small redlines to the SOW and create the DocuSign envelope?
- Share the envelope link so our team can route for signature?

If we can get the envelope out the week of Feb 15, procurement expects signatures within 48 hours and we'll keep the 1 Mar start. Happy to hop on a 20-min call Thursday to confirm the shipping timeline if helpful.

Thanks — Elaine

LumenHealth
